main_text.p: plex,ut quæ prauos humores,& præfertim biliosos mebranis uentriculi impactos potentissimè euacuet. Enecat quoq; uermes in utroq; uentre natos,& per aluū euacuat: propterea epilepsiam ab his natā mirè tollit. Comitiales autem morbi, qui ab hepate,aut splene suam obtinet caufam, alui solutione,aut phlebotomia,aut utroq; profligari solent. Cum igitur omnium,qui cum primaria epilepsia conflictatur,salutis spes solis fere relinquatur infantibus, pueris & adolescentibus, & cæteros ad necè usq; comitetur hic affectus, idcirco illorum curationem maximè agrediemur,ab ea,quæ infantium est,auspicantes. Quapropter nutricis lac in primis esse temperatum, & excrementis liberum oportet. Vitiosum enim est,quod crassum est,aut tenue. Propterea hoc in crassandu : illud uero attenuandum ad aliquod usq; medium. Internoscitur autem lac colore,consistentia,& odore:colore quidem,ut & candidissimū sit,nulliusq; liuoris,aut fœtoris sit particeps : substantia uero non crassum,nec caseosum.Nam tale couulsiones potissimùm producere solet, &neruos obstruere,quemadmodum often dicit Tralianus. main_text.notes: Several words are printed with long s or ligatures; these are normalised. "tentissimè" (line 3) and "often" (line 26) are doubtful; "often" may be a misprint. "dicit" is read from a ligature. "crassandu" and "gari" are doubtful. The catchword "culis" is at the foot right.
